args.query: solve a sudoku with the OR-Tools CP-SAT solver in Python

results.title: MCP server with in-memory tools
results.summary: Build an McpServer from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk that registers two zod-typed tools and one resource, then exercise it offline through a Client linked by InMemoryTransport.createLinkedPair().

results.title: Vercel AI SDK tool loops, structured output and streaming with a mock model
results.summary: AI SDK generateText with a Zod-typed tool and a stopWhen step cap, Output.object structured results validated by Zod, and streamText deltas, all tested offline with MockLanguageModelV4 and simulateReadableStream from ai/test.

results.title: Structured JSON logs with python-json-logger, captured in tests
results.summary: Emit one JSON object per log record with python-json-logger 4.x, using extra fields, renamed keys, static fields, timestamp and exception info, and assert the parsed output offline.

results.title: GraphQL schema mocking with @graphql-tools/schema and @graphql-tools/mock
results.summary: Build an executable schema with makeExecutableSchema and layer deterministic mocks, a MockStore, MockList and partial real resolvers on top with addMocksToSchema, including mutations that write to the store.

results.title: Starlette multipart form uploads parsed with python-multipart, tested offline
results.summary: Parse multipart text fields and file uploads in Starlette with python-multipart, then exercise the app fully in-process through httpx.ASGITransport with no network.

results.title: python-docx report with styled tables and page breaks
results.summary: Generate a Word report with python-docx - a title, headings, a styled table and a page break - then reopen the .docx and verify structure, order and styling.

results.title: python-slugify + text-unidecode multilingual URL slugs
results.summary: Turn accented, Cyrillic and CJK titles into URL slugs with python-slugify, using text-unidecode for ASCII romanization or allow_unicode to keep scripts verbatim, then dedupe collisions.

results.title: Loading .env files with python-dotenv and pydantic-settings precedence rules
results.summary: Typed app settings from .env files with pydantic-settings, covering source precedence, layered env files, extra-key rules and python-dotenv override behavior, tested offline with tmp_path files.

results.title: LangChain.js tools with Zod schemas and a manual tool-calling loop
results.summary: Define LangChain.js tools with tool() and Zod schemas, run model tool_calls through them, and feed ToolMessages back, tested with a scripted fake chat model.

results.title: python-box dot-access config: frozen boxes, defaults and YAML/JSON roundtrip
results.summary: Build dot-access config objects with python-box, deep-merge overrides and defaults, take frozen read-only views, then convert back to plain dicts and round-trip through YAML and JSON.
